description: FeliX ISE provides an interactive interface for the FeliX global integrated-assessment model developed at IIASA. Radboud University and partner researchers expose controls and visualisations for population, economy, energy, land, food and climate interactions. The documented model uses calibration data from 1900–2020 and scenarios through 2100. Zenodo archives the interface under CC BY 4.0, while the current FeliXSim GitHub repository specifies EUPL-1.2; both are free, and users should follow the terms of the version obtained. Repository instructions describe a JavaScript web application built with SDEverywhere and WebAssembly tools. It supports scenario exploration, not asset-level network dispatch. Limitations of aggregation and behavioural assumptions affect local predictions. The interface was not installed or numerically tested, and no directly related catalogue platform was identified.
